risk_note: F1-08ed (orchestrator 2026-11-09 21:17; same class as F1-08ec r1 S1). Admin note / reason fields with a length cap now count Unicode code points like the servers do: new apps/admin/src/text-length.ts (codePointLength trims, rawCodePointLength counts the raw value) is used by 24 fields across recon (write-off, close), config-center, exports, kill-switches, pay-orders refund, risk, settle-bills, unions (six dialogs), users; character counters use count.strategy on the same counting, native maxLength / Form max rules that cut by UTF-16 units are removed. Fields whose value is sent untrimmed (kill-switches, users reveal, exports retry, risk enable / disable, users relations level / inviter) count the raw value. Credentials, order numbers, search boxes, SMS fields, URLs and OTP are out of scope. The test author checked every in-scope endpoint counts code points (explicit [...s].length or contract maxLength via Ajv), so no backend ticket. Rule tests by an independent Claude in two rounds; Codex spec-test r1 fail (S1 bare showCount) -> r2 pass; red on the local container. Implementation by Opus 5.5: local container fast-1 and browser-1 green (admin-note-length 19 and every frozen admin test), run.ts static 10/10. The review tool classifies the task as RV2 (pay-orders / settle-bills note fields under pages/**): Codex money review r1 pass with one S2 (shared ReasonField shows the raw count where two callers validate trimmed; logged as a follow-up). Written by hand.
